wiki.title: Scott Hill (politician)
wiki.extract: Scott Hill is an American politician. He has served as a member of the Kansas Senate since 2025, representing the 24th district. He previously served in the Kansas House of Representatives from 2023 to 2025, representing the 70th district. He is a member of the Republican Party. Hill was appointed to the Kansas Senate in June 2025 after J. R. Claeys was appointed Administrator of the Rural Business-Cooperative Service at the USDA.
